rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Failure of conservative treatment* for a minimum of six (6) weeks within the last six (6) months: NOTE - Failure of conservative treatment is defined as one of the following: ○ Lack of meaningful improvement after a full course of treatment; OR ○ Progression or worsening of symptoms during treatment; OR ○ Documentation of a medical reason the member is unable to participate in treatment

criteria.description: Evaluation of non-emergent neck pain without acute progressive cord compression
Completion of at least six (6) consecutive weeks of conservative therapy within the prior six (6) months
Conservative therapy completed within the preceding 6 months
Documented failure (lack of improvement, progression, or medically documented contraindication)

required_documentation: Physical therapy notes with attendance logs showing 6 weeks of active therapy
Physician clinical follow-up notes documenting persistence of symptoms post-therapy
rules.review_notes: Standard conservative care prerequisite with 6-week trial within last 6 months.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Evaluation of Suspected Myelopathy (11,12) ● Progressive symptoms including hand clumsiness, worsening handwriting, difficulty with grasping and holding objects, diffuse numbness in the hands, pins and needles sensation, increasing difficulty with balance and ambulation ● Any of the neurological deficits as noted above NOTE: Does NOT require conservative care

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of cervical myelopathy with progressive upper extremity dysfunction or balance difficulty
Objective neurological exam findings (hyperreflexia, clonus, gait instability, Babinski)

required_documentation: Neurological or orthopedic physical examination documenting myelopathic signs (hyperreflexia, Hoffman, Babinski, gait disturbance)
rules.review_notes: Explicit policy exception stating cervical myelopathy does NOT require conservative treatment prior to advanced MRI.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Suspected cervical cord compression with any neurological deficits as listed above

criteria.description: Suspected acute cervical spinal cord compression with objective neurological deficit

required_documentation: Neurology or spine surgery physical exam documenting motor weakness, sensory level, or hyperreflexia
rules.review_notes: Urgent cervical cord compression indication bypassing conservative treatment.
